mean_en: if something is hopeless, there is no hope that it will get better or succeed; extremely bad; (of people) very bad (at something); with no ability or skill; feeling or showing no hope
sentence: I feel hopeless. This job is not easy.
sentence_trans: 我绝望了，这个工作真不简单。
word_etyma: hope希望 + less表形容词，无……的 → hopeless无希望的
